title: Oracle - SCM and Procurement - SCM-Functional Consultant - Senior
description:
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain Management (SCM) and Procurement (PROC) Functional Consultant at Senior level with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience. The successful candidate will independently support and deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation, transformation, rollout and support engagements across Procurement and related SCM areas, including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Procurement Contracts, Inventory Management, Order Management, Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Cost Management, Maintenance and Logistics. The role requires strong hands-on functional capability, client-facing delivery experience and relevant industry/domain expertise to translate real-world source-to-pay and supply-chain requirements into scalable Oracle Fusion solutions. Knowledge of Oracle Redwood user experience and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio is also expected.
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**
•Deliver Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and Procurement implementation, transformation, rollout and support activities from requirements gathering through design, configuration, testing, deployment and stabilization.
  
•Manage assigned workstream tasks, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality and stakeholder updates under the guidance of the project lead or manager.
  
•Facilitate business workshops, assess current-state industry processes and translate requirements into scalable future-state Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions aligned with leading practices.
  
•Perform functional fit-gap analysis, configuration, prototyping, conference room pilots, testing, training, cutover and go-live support.
  
•Design integrated source-to-pay, procure-to-pay and supply-chain solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Order Management, Cost Management and related SCM modules, coordinating dependencies with Payables, Finance, Projects, reporting, integration, security and data teams.
  
•Prepare high-quality functional designs, configuration workbooks, process flows, test artefacts, user guides and training materials in line with Oracle implementation methodologies.
  
•Assess Oracle Redwood readiness, support business-process redesign for Redwood pages and guided experiences, and execute adoption, testing and change-impact activities.
  
•Identify suitable SCM use cases for Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio and support the definition of agent topics, instructions, tools, data access, human-approval checkpoints and expected outcomes.
  
•Collaborate with technical, security and integration teams to configure, test, publish and monitor AI agents and agentic workflows within Oracle Fusion.
  
•Follow responsible AI controls covering role-based access, data privacy, traceability, testing, monitoring and business-owner approval.
  
•Support SIT, UAT, regression testing, cutover and production support, and drive timely resolution of defects and functional queries.
  
•Contribute to client presentations, solution demonstrations, estimates, proposals, knowledge assets and practice-development initiatives.
  
•Guide junior consultants, review assigned deliverables and maintain delivery quality and internal KPIs.
  
  
  
Requirements
  
  
**Experience:**
•Minimum 5 years of relevant Oracle SCM and Procurement experience, including strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  
•At least two end-to-end ERP implementation or transformation engagements, including at least one Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM implementation.
  
•Strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion Procurement—including Self Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Qualification and Management, Supplier Portal and Procurement Contracts—together with hands-on knowledge of at least one core SCM area such as Inventory Management, Order Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Planning, Product Management, Cost Management, Maintenance or Logistics.
  
•Hands-on experience with source-to-pay and procure-to-pay process design, enterprise structures, procurement business units, requisitioning, purchasing, approvals, catalogs, supplier onboarding, sourcing, contracts, receiving, integrations, data migration, reporting and operational controls.
  
•Practical knowledge of Oracle Redwood UX, including Redwood page adoption, process redesign, extension considerations, testing and end-user change management.
  
•Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio, including agent configuration concepts, topics, instructions, tools, workflow orchestration, deployment, security and monitoring.
  
•Ability to support high-value agentic SCM use cases, such as supplier onboarding assistance, procurement policy guidance, order exception management, inventory insights or planning support.
  
•Client-facing delivery experience with sound planning, estimation, risk management, testing and quality assurance capabilities.
  
•Demonstrable industry/domain experience in at least one sector—such as retail, government, energy, real estate, oil and gas, manufacturing, utilities, logistics or consumer products—with practical understanding of sector-specific procurement, supplier, inventory, fulfilment, planning and operational-control requirements.
  
**Competencies / Skills:**
•Strong stakeholder management, consulting, collaboration and junior-team mentoring skills.
  
•Ability to independently manage assigned functional workstreams, priorities and deliverables within agreed timelines.
  
•Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills, with the ability to explain business and functional concepts clearly.
  
•Strong analytical, industry-process design, problem-solving and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to apply domain knowledge to Oracle Fusion SCM and Procurement solutions.
  
•Sound understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, access controls, human oversight and governance for enterprise agentic solutions.
  
•Awareness of Oracle quarterly updates and the ability to assess new SCM, Redwood and embedded-AI capabilities for business adoption.
  
•Proficiency in delivery and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent.
  
•Valid passport and willingness to travel to client sites and work MENA business schedules, including Sunday to Thursday, where required.
  
**Education:**
•Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, Information Systems or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
•Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM and/or Procurement certification in relevant modules is preferred; credentials or demonstrated training in Oracle Redwood and Oracle Fusion AI Agent Studio are an added advantage.

* Good to have CSM/PSM, CAPM/Prince2/PMP, Project Management Fundamentals or Six sigma certification
* Prior experience of 2+ years in creative and content designing, preferably working on drafting responses on RFPs/RFIs
* Professional services design teams or advertising agencies exposure with consulting firms are a big plus
* Adobe cloud software's like Photoshop, InDesign, Illustrator, After effects, Premiere Pro
* Proficiency in Microsoft applications (PowerPoint, Excel - charts and graphs and Word)
* Blender, Templafy, Deck Robot and other leading applications

* Familiarity with animation and creating storyboard marketing videos are valued skills.
* Involvement during presales stages
* Exposure with building Murals and Visio flow
* Web design and understanding of user interface principles are good to have.
* Strong English communication - both written and verbal
* Attention to detail even when dealing with routine tasks
* Confident, Assertive, with strong communication and influencing skills
* Ability to comprehend EYs business, think strategically, adapt to change
* Experience with go to market activities, should have proposal drafting and strong presentation skills
* Ability to identify problems, perform research, solve complex business problems and recommend solutions
* Prior experience working with Global cliental required
* Self-starter, excellent team player, organized and self-disciplined. Ability to work with senior leadership

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role
  
  
with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**

The role requires a blend of banking domain expertise, platform implementation experience, business analysis capabilities, and practical understanding of AI-powered solutions.

* Conduct gap analysis, solution assessments, impact analysis, and support business process re-engineering initiatives.

description:

Vidyalai is an Ed-Tech startup revolutionising education by providing personalised learning solutions to students worldwide. We focus primarily on the secondary and higher education market, serving middle school, high school, and college students. Founded by a team of IIT Madras alumni, Vidyalai has rapidly emerged as one of India's fastest-growing startups, with a global user base spanning over 30 countries. Performance bonus

description: Business Growth Owner (BGO) Type: Full-time Location: Kochi, Kerala, India Travel: Required Experience: Freshers welcome, up to a few years (sales experience is a plus) Salary: Rs 30,000–45,000 per month (tentative, based on experience) About Riafy Riafy Technologies Private Limited is an AI innovation company headquartered in Kochi, Kerala, building enterprise-scale AI agents for organisations around the world. Founded in 2013 by six engineering graduates, Riafy began by building consumer applications that today serve over 125 million users in 23 languages across 157 countries. More than a decade of this experience now underpins R10, Riafy's enterprise AI platform. R10 enables organisations to deploy AI agents that go beyond answering questions to completing real work, from booking tickets and processing orders to guiding customers and supporting service teams. Riafy currently operates more than 150 live AI services and has processed over 1 trillion tokens in production enterprise environments. Its AI agents serve leading brands including IndiGo, Asian Paints, Lakmé, MG Motor, Federal Bank and Banglalink. Riafy is a premium Agentic AI partner of Google Cloud and Meta. Its recognitions include the Google Cloud Partner Award 2026 for Social Impact: Accessibility Innovation, the Google Cloud Partner Award 2024 for Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (APAC), and The Economic Times AI Product of the Year 2026. Riafy was also showcased at Google I/O every year from 2015 to 2019. As a Business Growth Owner, you will help bring Riafy's story to new clients and partners. About the Role In simple words: you are the first point of contact between Riafy and potential clients and partners. You start conversations, understand what they need, bring in our product and tech teams at the right time, and keep the conversation moving until it becomes a business opportunity. We are looking for a Business Growth Owner to support Riafy's client and partner engagement. The role involves managing external communication, coordinating pre-sales activities (the steps that happen before a client signs, such as meetings and demos), identifying relevant business opportunities, and building relationships through industry events and networking. You will work closely with internal teams to understand client requirements, coordinate meetings and product demonstrations, maintain follow-ups, and keep business conversations moving forward. You will work directly with the founder. This role suits someone who communicates clearly, takes initiative, stays organised, and is comfortable interacting with clients and partners. What You Will Do Manage communication with prospective clients and partners, keeping each conversation organised and replying on time. Coordinate pre-sales activities: first discovery meetings (understanding the client's needs), product demos, POC discussions (small trial projects to show our solution works) and follow-ups. Attend industry events, conferences and networking opportunities to start conversations and identify potential clients and partners. Understand what prospects need and work with internal teams to find the right solution and next steps. Track leads, keep accurate records of every interaction, and make sure no follow-up is missed. Check with internal teams that everything shared with clients is accurate, and that any commitment made is something we can deliver. Help move promising opportunities towards a deal, and support business development initiatives, proposals and client presentations as required. Travel for client meetings, industry events and other business requirements. What We Are Looking For Clear verbal and written communication skills. Confidence in starting and managing professional conversations. Good listening, questioning and problem-solving skills. Strong organisational skills and attention to follow-ups and details. Ability to coordinate with multiple people and manage competing priorities. Curiosity to understand business needs and quick learning of Riafy's products and solutions. Professional judgement, honesty and accountability when communicating with clients and partners. Willingness to attend events and travel as required. Good to have (not mandatory): sales acumen or experience in sales, negotiation or client handling; experience with events or networking; comfort with CRM tools, spreadsheets and presentations. Who can apply: Freshers, and candidates with a few years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, pre-sales or client coordination. If you have sales acumen, we would love to hear from you. A technical background is not mandatory; we will train you on Riafy's products. What Success Looks Like Prospects and partners get quick, clear and accurate responses. You build a steady pipeline of conversations, meetings and demos. Leads are tracked well and follow-ups are never missed. Clients trust you because you are honest about what Riafy can deliver. What You Get Direct exposure to the founder and to real client decisions. Hands-on experience selling enterprise AI to well-known brands. Training on Riafy's products and services. Growth towards senior ownership roles. Riafy is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage women candidates to apply

: 25%–50% across KSA, UAE and Qatar, engagement-dependent

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client delivery and engagement leadership**

* Lead concurrent learning and change engagements across scope, solution, quality, financials, resourcing, risk and client satisfaction.
* Own solution architecture across capability models, learning strategy, learning journeys, curriculum, change and adoption, technology enablement, measurement and sustainment.
* Manage engagement economics including effort, margin, realisation, change control and revenue recognition against plan.
* Lead stakeholder interviews, executive workshops, design sessions, steering reviews and client presentations.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and address delivery risks and escalations promptly.

**Learning transformation and change strategy**

* Lead learning needs analysis, capability diagnostics, skills mapping and workforce upskilling roadmaps.
* Design learning operating models, academies, curriculum architectures, blended journeys and outcome measurement frameworks.
* Design change and adoption strategies for digital, operating model, regulatory and workforce transformations.
* Integrate stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, capability building, reinforcement and benefits realisation into learning solutions.
* Support leadership assessment-led development solutions, including assessment administration and interpretation through suitably accredited practitioners.

**Pursuits, proposals and market development**

* Lead L&D and change pursuits from qualification through win themes, solution design, delivery model, workplan, staffing, assumptions, pricing inputs and oral presentations.
* Translate RFP and client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially sound solutions under tight timelines.
* Develop capability showcases, credentials, case studies, proposal content and reusable response assets.
* Partner with MENA account teams, subject-matter specialists, finance and delivery leaders to improve proposal quality and conversion.
* Identify account extensions and cross-portfolio opportunities with OCM, HRT, OWT and Design Theatre capabilities.

**AI-enabled learning and innovation**

* Apply Microsoft Copilot and other approved generative AI tools to research, proposal development, learning design and content acceleration in line with firm policies.
* Shape AI-enabled learning solutions, including a learning content generation accelerator, personalised learning journeys and learning analytics use cases.
* Define appropriate human review, quality, privacy, intellectual property and risk controls for AI-assisted deliverables.
* Contribute to at least one client-facing AI-enabled learning accelerator or innovation use case.

**Practice and people leadership**

* Coach Senior and Staff consultants, review client deliverables and build consulting, learning, change and AI capability across the team.
* Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, deployment, utilisation planning and certification pathways.
* Build and maintain the capability repository, proposal repository and case-study repository.
* Develop reusable methodologies, accelerators, estimation models, service descriptions and delivery playbooks.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Commercial and consulting judgement: Structures ambiguous problems, builds credible solutions and manages engagement economics.
* Learning and change integration: Applies learning strategy and change management together to deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Pursuit leadership: Creates clear win themes, compelling proposal narratives and realistic delivery approaches.
* Executive communication and facilitation: Leads workshops and presents recommendations with clarity and confidence.
* AI fluency: Uses AI responsibly to improve speed and quality and can shape AI-enabled learning solutions.
* Builder mindset: Is comfortable creating repeatable capability while delivering client work in a lean, growth-stage team.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 11–15 years of relevant experience across L&D consulting, learning transformation and organisational change management, including substantial client-facing consulting experience.
* Proven end-to-end engagement leadership with responsibility for quality, team, financials and client outcomes.
* Demonstrable experience leading pursuits, developing proposals and shaping learning or change solutions.
* Depth in learning strategy, needs analysis, curriculum and journey design, facilitation, evaluation and capability building.
* Working knowledge of change impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and reinforcement.
* Hands-on, responsible use of generative AI and Microsoft Copilot for consulting, proposals and learning work.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, education, organisational development, psychology or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated business-level Arabic proficiency in reading, writing and speaking, sufficient to review proposal content, participate in stakeholder discussions and support workshops. Proficiency will be assessed through a role-relevant practical evaluation.

**Preferred**

* GCC or MENA market experience, particularly in government, energy or financial services.
* Big Four or global consulting experience.
* Experience in managed learning services, learning operating model design, leadership development or leadership assessment-led development.
* Exposure to LXP, AI learning platforms, talent marketplaces and learning analytics.
* Experience with platforms such as SuccessFactors Learning, Cornerstone, Workday Learning, Degreed or similar, and digital adoption tools such as WalkMe or SAP Enable Now.
* Experience with learning design and content tools such as Articulate 360, Vyond, Camtasia or comparable platforms.

**CERTIFICATIONS**
**Required At Joining Or Within The Agreed Development Plan**

* PROSCI or equivalent recognised change certification
* Design thinking / human-centred design
* Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI or comparable applied AI credential
* Agile or Scrum awareness/certification

**Preferred / Differentiating**

* CPTD / APTD or equivalent learning credential
* CCMP
* Kirkpatrick evaluation credential
* Hogan, SHL or Korn Ferry accreditation
* Learning analytics or platform certification

**WAYS OF WORKING**

* Initial ramp-up: approximately 50% client delivery, 30% pursuits and proposals, 10% capability building and 10% internal initiatives, subject to demand and staffing.
* Once deployed to a billable engagement: approximately 70% client delivery and 30% pursuits, proposal support and capability building, subject to engagement commitments and portfolio priorities.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES: FIRST 12 MONTHS**
**Delivery**

* Engagements delivered to agreed scope, quality, financial and client-satisfaction targets.
* Project plans, financial reports, quality reviews and client feedback.

**Pursuits**

* Support at least 15 strategic pursuits and lead solution development for at least 5 major proposals, subject to pipeline volume.
* Pursuit tracker and proposal records.

**Commercial contribution**

* Demonstrable contribution to portfolio revenue through billable delivery, wins or account extension.Individual target to be calibrated to the approved portfolio plan
* Revenue, pipeline and account records.

**Stakeholders**

* Build effective working relationships with up to 5 priority MENA sponsors or account leaders.
* Stakeholder plan and opportunity activity.

**Capability assets**

* Create or materially improve at least 5 reusable credentials, case studies, methods, estimates or proposal assets.
* Controlled repository and reuse log.

**AI and innovation**

* Help develop one client-facing AI-enabled learning accelerator or use case and evidence responsible AI adoption in pursuits and delivery.
* Demo, use-case record or client deliverable.

**People**

* Coach 3–5 junior consultants and maintain documented development and certification plans.
* Counselling records and development plans.

**Utilisation and operating model**

* Meet the approved utilisation target and agreed delivery/BD allocation, with exceptions re-based when staffing materially changes.
* Utilisation and resource reports.

**What Ey Offers**

* Exposure to live MENA learning, change and workforce transformation programmes.
* A role that combines client delivery, solution shaping, capability building and market development.
* Opportunities to develop dual capability across learning consulting and organisational change.
* Hands-on experience with modern learning technology, AI-enabled content and analytics.
* The opportunity to help shape a growing Learning & Change portfolio rather than inherit a fixed model.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
**GTM Engineer**

**Talentz.ai · Full-time · On-site, Kochi, India · Overlap with US Central mornings**

**About Talentz.ai**

Hiring lacks signal. Resumes have become cheap to generate and nearly identical, so companies receive more applications and less information. Talentz.ai builds Zee, an agentic hiring system that brings verified signal into sourcing, engagement and evaluation, with every decision auditable. We work with US startups and growth-stage companies that hire senior and specialized talent without a dedicated talent acquisition team.

**About the role**

This role combines marketing and SDR in one seat, and it runs on AI. You find the right companies and the communities where their founders spend time, start the right conversations, and run discovery calls and product demos yourself. Agents do the volume work. You design the workflows, make the judgment calls and own the outcome: qualified meetings with companies that have a real hiring need.

**What you will do**

1. **Signal-based targeting.**
   Build and maintain target account lists from live hiring signals such as recent funding, new job posts, leadership changes and headcount growth. Score and prioritize accounts every week.
2. **Community engine.**
   Map where our customers live: founder communities, Slack and Discord groups, Reddit and LinkedIn groups, forums, accelerator networks, conferences and meetups. Build a repeatable, AI-run system that tracks them, surfaces relevant conversations and events, and engages with useful contributions, not pitches.
3. **AI-run outbound.**
   Own email and LinkedIn sequences end to end: enrichment, personalization, sending infrastructure, deliverability and reply routing. Agents handle the volume; you own quality and conversion.
4. **Discovery calls and demos.**
   Run discovery calls and product demos consistently to meet weekly meeting and pipeline targets. Qualify the hiring need, show how Zee solves it, and hand qualified opportunities to leadership to close.
5. **The GTM stack.**
   Run and connect the CRM, enrichment, sequencing and community monitoring tools, alongside our own Zee agents. Keep data clean and attribution honest.
6. **Experiments.**
   Ship two or more experiments a week across message, segment, channel and community. Stop what fails quickly and scale what works.
7. **Events and webinars.**
   Automate registration filtering and follow-up for our monthly working sessions, and run outreach before and after the conferences we attend.
8. **Reporting.**
   Share a weekly pipeline view: accounts and communities reached, reply rates, discovery calls, demos, qualified meetings and the source of each.

**Your first 90 days**

**By day 30:**
You own all email campaigns, the stack is documented, deliverability is healthy, and 500+ signal-qualified accounts are live. You have mapped the top 30 communities and events where our customers gather, and you are co-running discovery calls.

**By day 60:**
Weekly experiments are running, the community engagement system is live, and you run discovery calls and demos on your own.

**By day 90:**
You run a repeatable engine across outbound and communities that meets the weekly demo target, with cost per meeting known by segment and channel.

**What you bring**

* 3 to 6 years across growth engineering, marketing operations, RevOps or a technical SDR/BDR role at a B2B SaaS company
* Experience running discovery calls and product demos with B2B buyers against a meeting target, ideally with US founders or executives
* Hands-on experience with Clay, Apollo, HubSpot or similar, and sending tools such as Instantly, Smartlead or Lemlist
* Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, Python or JavaScript, and SQL
* LLM-powered workflows you built that ran in production (prompting, agents, n8n, Make or Zapier)
* An understanding of how founder communities work and how to add value without being seen as spam
* Email deliverability fundamentals: domains, warm-up, SPF, DKIM and DMARC
* Clear written and spoken English, and the judgment to talk with a US founder or CTO without sounding scripted
* Comfort working with a US team across time zones and owning outcomes without being chased

**Nice to have**

* You have built an outbound engine from zero and can show the numbers
* You have sold to, or recruited for, US startups
* Experience in HR tech, recruiting tech or developer tools

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary with a performance bonus tied to pipeline
* Employee stock options
* Work from our Kochi office, directly with the founding team and a US customer base
* An agent-native team where your leverage comes from the systems you build

**How to apply**

Apply through this posting and include one example of an outbound or automation engine you built, with its results. Our process is a short screening call, a paid work sample of four hours or less, and two interviews.

***PriceSenz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.***

title: GDS M and E - Sourcing Specialist
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.
  
  
This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

+ Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.
+ Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.
+ Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.
+ Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.
+ Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

* Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

+ Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.
+ Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.
+ Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.
+ Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

* Hospitality & Industry Expertise

+ Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.
+ Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis
- Attrition and cancellation clauses
- Food & Beverage minimum commitments
- Meeting room rental structures
- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies
- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing
- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses
- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

+ Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.
+ Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.
+ Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.
+ Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.
+ Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

* Supplier Performance & Governance

+ Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations.
+ Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities.
+ Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships.

* Reporting & Process Improvement

+ Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management.
+ Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies.
+ Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA
+ Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.
* Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.
* Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.
* Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.
* Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.
* Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.
* Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**
We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The ideal candidate will combine strong market knowledge, supplier relationship management and strategic thinking to deliver best-in-class sourcing solutions while supporting EY's global Meetings & Events programme objectives.

Full-time

On-site

Company Description

A&S Management Consultancy, based in Bahrain, is a trusted partner for organizations seeking expert management consultancy services. The firm combines deep knowledge of local market dynamics with global best practices to deliver strategic, tailored solutions. Its services include business advisory, company formation and amendments, company liquidation, and accounting and bookkeeping support for businesses at various stages of growth.

As an authorized Zoho Partner, A&S provides integrated Zoho solutions to streamline business operations, improve productivity, and support digital transformation. With a client-centric approach, the company focuses on helping businesses overcome challenges and achieve sustainable, long-term growth.

Role Description

The Operations Coordinator will be responsible for supporting the smooth day-to-day operations of consultancy services, client management, administrative activities, and business development. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi.

The role involves coordinating operational workflows, maintaining documentation, assisting with basic accounting activities, managing client communications, tracking leads, conducting product demonstrations, and following up with prospective customers to support sales conversion.

The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, comfortable multitasking, and capable of coordinating with clients and internal teams while maintaining high standards of service and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate daily operational activities and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Manage client communications, inquiries, appointments, meetings, and follow-ups.
* Maintain company records, client documentation, reports, and project-related information.
* Assist with basic accounting activities, including invoice preparation, expense tracking, payment follow-ups, and maintaining financial records.
* Manage incoming leads, maintain the CRM database, and follow up with prospective clients.
* Conduct product demonstrations and presentations for Zoho applications, ERP systems, and other business software solutions.
* Understand customer requirements, explain suitable solutions, address basic objections, and support lead conversion and deal closing.
* Coordinate with technical and implementation teams to track project progress and ensure timely delivery.
* Prepare operational reports, update performance metrics, and monitor pending tasks.
* Provide administrative support, including scheduling, documentation, and office coordination.
* Handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously while prioritizing urgent tasks and meeting deadlines.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements to internal processes and customer experience.
* Support sales and business development activities to help the company achieve its business objectives.

Qualifications and Skills

* **Operations Management:**
  Ability to coordinate workflows, manage daily activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure adherence to internal processes.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills for interacting with clients, colleagues, and prospective customers.
* **Lead Management and Closing Skills:**
  Ability to follow up on leads, understand customer requirements, handle objections, negotiate professionally, and convert prospects into customers.
* **Product Demonstration Skills:**
  Confidence in conducting software demonstrations and presentations, particularly for Zoho applications, ERP systems, and business management solutions.
* **Basic Accounting Skills:**
  Understanding of basic accounting principles, invoice preparation, expense tracking, payment follow-ups, and financial record maintenance.
* **Multitasking and Time Management:**
  Ability to manage multiple assignments, handle competing priorities, meet deadlines, and coordinate operations, administration, accounting, and sales activities.
* **Customer Service:**
  Ability to handle customer inquiries professionally, resolve routine issues, and maintain positive client relationships.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Ability to track leads, monitor performance indicators, prepare reports, and support business decisions.
* **Administrative Skills:**
  Experience in maintaining records, preparing documents, scheduling meetings, and supporting office operations.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Working knowledge of MS Office, Excel or Google Sheets, CRM systems, and ERP software. Familiarity with Zoho applications is an advantage.
* **Teamwork and Adaptability:**
  Ability to work independently and collaboratively, learn new systems quickly, and adapt to changing business requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Accounting, Marketing, or a related field.
* Prior experience in operations coordination, customer support, inside sales, business development, or software consultancy is an advantage.
* Experience with Zoho products, ERP software, accounting systems, or CRM platforms is desirable.
* A target-oriented mindset with an interest in customer engagement, software solutions, and business growth.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a responsible, organized, and proactive professional who can manage daily operations while supporting customer relationships and business development. The candidate should be comfortable with basic accounting, multitasking, software demonstrations, lead follow-ups, and sales conversion activities.

The ideal candidate will combine strong coordination and administrative abilities with a customer-focused approach and a willingness to learn business software solutions.

Must Have

* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Assistant Manager - Entertainment PRS, Malayalam
description:
* Job Summary To work with the Sales team to support part of the business of the respective cluster. The incumbent will act as a key link between Programming/Content team and Sales teams and drive the brand philosophy and sales/revenue strategy for the channel to maximize revenue. This will be done through effective forecasting, planning, pricing and property integrations based on deep understanding of customer needs and patterns.

The incumbent will play a critical role in developing a comprehensive roadmap and vision for our business, studying industry-specific trends, and creating compelling narratives to drive monetization growth. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical and communication skills, as well as the ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Creating revenue business plan across portfolio, defining the pricing strategy along with the Channel PRS Head for the channel/cluster basis organization objectives, budget for the year, market scenario, competition, etc. in order to ensure the sales organization achieves overall revenue target.
* Driving the channel pricing agenda - setting benchmarks, providing inputs and sign-offs on deals, and participating in deal negotiations as and when required
* Build client wise strategy/ deal structuring for the channel which includes creating and recommending client pricing options for individual client deals, building monthly client packages including decisions on what time bands to allocate to each client based on what works for their target segments and track deviations in delivery
* Build sponsor packages for impact shows and ensure maximum monetization for each property on the channel
* Build band wise revenue budget, show and property wise pricing including determination of sponsor packages
* Create and maintain strategies based on key genres to help understand the genre behavior, trends, movements etc. that may have impact on business.
* Building bottom-up revenue plans for the fiscal, quarter & month
* Tracking performance vs. annual plan, revising forecasts etc.
* Developing insights into the genre & channel deliveries to develop customized pitches for clients
* Creating & implementing trade marketing agenda for the channel – Mailers, On Air promos, Trade events etc.
* Define a measurement process to ensure that client and agency are aligned on key performance metrics, establishing realistic business goals, and providing frontline support through reporting and analytics
* Impact landscape sizing of a particular genre – understand the kind of impact properties across channels, changes and evolutions compared to the previous year and deeper understanding of the advertisers who buy impact
* Engage with sales teams for ensuring revenue rationalization by forecasting projections/trends for a healthy business and designing attractive packages for the sales team to take to the market, conducting roadshows. Prepare the sales team so they can handle queries from clients and media planners/buyers with confidence.
* Supporting ad sales team with operational tasks on rate cards, internal deal approvals, client sales proposals etc.
* Liaise with the Programming teams and build a thorough understanding of the channel objectives and performance in order to identify monetization opportunities, as also provide market / sales feedback in relation to channel properties
* Work collaboratively across Sales and Ops to ensure seamless delivery on deals from a client perspective, as well as inventory optimization and revenue maximization from a business perspective
* Helps building client dockets to understand the advertising patterns for key advertisers versus competition genre wise, channel wise, brand wise, market wise and make recommendations basis the same to improve the efficiency of clients’ buys
* Skills & Attributes for success

Business Acumen
  
  

* Strategic planning
* Influencing Skills
* Result Orientation
* Negotiation Skills
* Analytical thinking
* Strategic planning
* Leadership
* Preferred Education & Experience

Minimum Qualification: MBA
  
  

* 5+ years of post-qualification experience
* Business consulting/ strategy background preferred

*Perched firmly at the nucleus of spellbinding content and innovative technology, JioStar is a leading global media & entertainment company that is reimagining the way audiences consume entertainment and sports. Its television network and steaming service together reach more than 750 million viewers every week, igniting the dreams and aspirations of hundreds of million people across geographies.*

title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Enterprise  partnerships Lead
description:
Job Description: Enterprise Partnerships Lead
  
  
Company: Glaring Labs (early-stage fintech)
  
Location: Kochi / Mumbai (frequent travel)
  
Experience: 5+ years
  
Reports to: Founder/CEO
  
  
About Glaring Labs
  
  
Glaring Labs is building a new commerce-linked financial product that helps large merchants drive committed customer spend and repeat purchases. We work with regulated banking and financial partners. We're pre-launch and hiring the person who will sign our first enterprise merchants.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You will own enterprise merchant acquisition end-to-end: pitch, commercial negotiation, legal and procurement, and go-live. This is a closer's role, not a lead-generation role.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
• Build and close the pipeline. Build and close a pipeline of large enterprise merchants across retail, utilities, fuel, and consumer categories.
  
• Sell at the right level. Sell to CFO, CMO, Head of Loyalty, and Head of Payments, and map the full buying committee.
  
• Negotiate commercial partnership agreements. Own the terms, pricing, and co-marketing commitments.
  
• Build business cases. Show the merchant's revenue, customer acquisition cost, and working capital impact.
  
• Run public-sector processes. Navigate PSU procurement, including empanelment, tenders, and committee approvals.
  
• Coordinate internally. Work with our banking partners and tech team so that what you sell is deliverable.
  
• Drive time-to-live. Push from signature to live integration.
  
• Feed the product. Bring structured merchant feedback into the roadmap.
  
  
Must-Haves
  
  
• 5+ years of B2B enterprise sales or partnerships, with at least 4 years selling to large retailers, PSUs, or national brands.
  
• A proven record of closing multi-crore annual contracts with 6–12 month cycles.
  
• Background in payments, merchant acquiring, affordability or EMI programs, loyalty, or bank merchant partnerships.
  
• A strong grasp of merchant economics, including MDR, settlement cycles, and promotional funding.
  
• Existing CXO-level relationships at large Indian retailers or PSUs.
  
• Comfort negotiating MSAs with legal and procurement.
  
• Malayalam is a plus.
  
  
Good to Have
  
  
• Experience selling to government bodies or state utilities.
  
• Exposure to RBI-regulated products.
  
• Having been the first sales hire at an early-stage startup.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
Timeline Target
  
90 days 2 enterprise merchants at term-sheet stage
  
6 months 2 merchants signed and live, and a PSU empanelment underway
  
12 months 8+ live enterprise merchants
  
  
Compensation
  
  
Competitive fixed pay, a significant performance variable, and ESOPs.

EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening
  
  
up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. * Identify and acquire New-to-Bank (NTB) overseas Indian (OI) opportunities from both new and existing corporate clients, consistently achieving OI NTB targets as defined in the Customer Strategic Plan (CSP).
* Ensure full compliance with the bank’s Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) policies and regulatory requirements at all times.
* Plan and execute localized marketing events and promotional activities in collaboration with internal marketing and support teams such as INM MKT to generate business leads within the designated catchment area.

* Consistently deliver fair outcomes for customers while upholding personal and professional conduct that supports the integrity, transparency, and orderly operation of financial markets.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage client relationships.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, and regulatory requirements is an advantage.
* Pro Tip: Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage .

You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

What if your career in architecture went beyond drawings and designs?

At
**trueceil™**
, we believe ceilings are more than just functional elements. They are an opportunity to shape spaces, create visual impact, and bring architectural ideas to life.

We are building a new generation of architectural metal ceiling solutions designed for contemporary spaces. As we grow, we are looking for an
**Architectural Solutions Manager**
who is passionate about architecture, curious about materials and technical design, and excited to work closely with architects, interior designers, and project teams.

This is an opportunity to step into the world of
**architectural products, ceiling systems, technical specifications, and design-led business development,**
gaining practical experience in how products are presented, specified, and selected for real projects.

If you enjoy understanding how things are designed, explaining how they work, and helping turn design concepts into practical solutions, this role could be the beginning of an exciting career.

**What Will You Do?**

1. Work with Architects & Designers

·       Build professional relationships with architects, interior designers, consultants, and design studios.

·       Understand project requirements and explore how trueceil™ products can complement their design concepts.

·       Present suitable ceiling systems, finishes, configurations, and applications for different spaces.

·       Help design professionals discover new possibilities in architectural metal ceilings.

·       Prepare compelling product presentations, digital brochures, technical documents, and visual references.

·       Create project-specific presentations that communicate product features, design possibilities, and application benefits.

·       Assist in developing material presentations and product showcases for architects and design teams.

·       Translate technical product information into clear, engaging, and professional presentations.

3. Coordinate Technical Specifications

·       Understand product dimensions, materials, finishes, installation systems, and application requirements.

·       Assist in preparing product specifications, technical submittals, and supporting documentation.

·       Coordinate with internal teams to address technical queries and identify suitable product configurations.

·       Support the specification process by helping ensure the right trueceil™ products are considered for relevant projects.

4. Explore Projects & Present Solutions

·       Identify upcoming projects where trueceil™ ceiling systems could be suitable.

·       Introduce products to prospective clients and present solutions based on their requirements.

·       Follow up on project discussions, product presentations, samples, and specification opportunities.

·       Coordinate with the sales and technical teams to help convert product interest into actual project opportunities.

5. Learn, Experiment & Grow

·       Develop an in-depth understanding of architectural ceiling systems and their applications.

·       Learn how architects evaluate materials, how specifications influence product selection, and how projects progress from design to execution.

·       Stay updated on architectural materials, interior trends, product innovations, and emerging design possibilities.

·       Contribute ideas to improve how trueceil™ products are presented, understood, and adopted by the design community.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are looking for someone who:

·       Has an interest in architecture, interior spaces, materials, and product design.

·       Enjoys communicating ideas, building relationships, and presenting information.

·       Is curious about technical details and willing to learn how architectural products work.

·       Can create clear, professional presentations and communicate confidently.

·       Is comfortable interacting with architects, designers, and other industry professionals.

·       Has a proactive mindset and the confidence to initiate conversations and follow up on opportunities.

·       Can balance creative thinking with technical accuracy and commercial awareness.

Fresh graduates with the right attitude are encouraged to apply.
Prior experience in architectural products, building materials, technical sales, or specification-related work is an advantage, but not essential.

**What Makes This Opportunity Different?**

A career at the intersection of design and business.

This is not a conventional sales role, nor is it a position limited to preparing drawings or documents.

You will learn how architectural products are evaluated, presented, specified, and selected, while developing the communication and commercial skills needed to work effectively with design professionals.

**You will gain exposure to:**

·       
**Architectural products:**
Understand metal ceiling systems, finishes, configurations, and applications.

·       
**Technical design:**
Develop knowledge of product details, system components, and application requirements.

·       
**Specification work:**
Learn how product specifications and technical submissions support project decisions.

·       
**Design communication:**
Present product possibilities and solutions to architects and interior designers.

·       
**Business development:**
Understand how relationships, project opportunities, and product specifications translate into business.

This role can be a strong foundation for a long-term career in architectural products, specification management, technical solutions, product management, or architectural business development.

**Why Join trueceil™?**

·       
**Build a specialised skill set:**
Develop knowledge in a growing area of architectural interior systems.

·       
**Work with design professionals:**
Engage directly with architects, designers, and project teams.

·       
**Learn beyond the classroom:**
Gain practical exposure to real projects, products, and specification processes.

·       
**Combine creativity with technical knowledge:**
Work with both the design possibilities and the practical requirements of ceiling systems.

·       
**Grow with an emerging brand:**
Be part of trueceil as it develops its presence in the architectural products market.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**

If you are looking for more than a routine job, and want to build expertise, develop professional relationships, and understand how architecture translates into real world product decisions, we would like to hear from you.

**Join TRUECEIL™ and help architects look at ceilings differently.**

**Apply now**
